ambiguity_notes: Grade field is 7.5 (consciousness wording): Grade 2 reading gives 7.7, Grade 3 reading gives 7.2. Not decided silently; documented value is the range 2 to 3. The patient also had lunch and was conversing at 12:30, so the closed eyes at 13:40 could be drowsiness; no sedatives or opioids were given, so no competing cause. Migraine history and Day +8 headache are excluded or irrelevant (section 4.2).
